'''lo turtau''' are lo [[tanru]] or parts of lo tanru that have a fixed meaning, which depends on their structure.

===turtau classes===
Warning: in colloquial Lojban lo tanru with lo turtau components may have meanings different from described here.
====seltau: "x1 (entity)" (aka adjective/adverbial)====
# '''barda''' seltau. '''lo barda broda''' = '''lo broda poi barda''', ''lo broda that is big''.
# '''cmalu''' seltau. '''lo cmalu broda''' = '''lo broda poi cmalu''', ''lo broda that is small''.
# '''zabna''' seltau.
# '''mabla''' seltau.
# '''blanu''' seltau
====seltau: "x1 (clause)"====
# '''cafne''' seltau. '''x1 cafne cadzu''' = '''x1 cadzu i ju'a nai lo nu go'i cu cafne''', ''x1 often walks''
# '''cerni'''/'''vanci''' seltau. '''x1 cerni sanmi''', ''x1 is a breakfast''
# '''zekri''' seltau. '''x1 zekri lebna''', ''x1 steals''

====seltau: "x1 (entity), x2 (property of x1)"====
# '''mutce''' seltau. '''x1 mutce broda''' unwraps into '''x1 mutce lo ka ce'u broda'''
# '''traji''' seltau. '''x1 traji broda''' unwraps into '''x1 traji lo ka ce'u broda'''

====others====
# disputable: '''simxu''' seltau. '''x1 simxu broda x2''' expands into '''x1 ce x2 simxu lo ka ce'u broda ce'u''', ''x1 and x2 reciprocally broda''
